newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sankyo shares rise on diabetes drug sale plan.
newsitem.headline: Sankyo shares rise on diabetes drug sale plan.

text.p: Japanese pharmaceutical firm Sankyo Co Ltd's shares rose on Friday morning, propelled by news the company had started preparations for the sale of a diabetes drug, brokers said.
As of 0158 GMT, the shares were 30 yen higher at 2,920 yen with a volume of 1.624 million shares, the 12th most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

On Thursday, a company spokesman said the company plans to launch the product by the end of March 1997. He gave no more details. The firm said in a statement that it postponed the launch of the drug last March.
